test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of these is NOT a benefit of the mpassport Police App?

options.text: It will not require police personnel to visit applicants’ homes.
It will reduce the processing time of passport issuance.
It will curtail misuse of the verification process.
It will allow submission of documents in digital format

solution:
The correct answer is** "It will not require police personnel to visit applicants homes."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage explicitly states that GPS and geo-tagging features of the mPassport Police App will establish whether police officials actually visited the applicant's home for verification. Thus, the app does not eliminate the need for police personnel to visit applicants' homes for physical verification. 
 
• The mPassport Police App does indeed shorten the processing time of passport issuance, by reducing the verification time from 15 to 5 days. Thus the second option is a benefit of the app according to the passage.
 
• Similarly, the application's transparent work process helps to tackle and curtail misuse of the verification process. Hence, the third option is also a benefit of the app.
 
• Lastly, the passage mentions that one of the app’s features is that it will allow the secure submission of documents in a digital format, making the fourth option another benefit of the app.

**Hence, the correct answer is 'Option 1'.**
